english.title: Waiting for excess time / in reserved area / non-parking area at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) waited, left or parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[in excess of the published waiting time limit in an area where waiting was restricted by a notice erected by London Luton Operations Limited]_
(B)_[in an area reserved for the use of a particular person or group of persons, namely **(..SPECIFY THE RESERVED USE..),]_
(C)_[in an area not specifically allocated for the parking of vehicles, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE / AREA..),]_

within Luton Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.6 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and place
wait / leave / park a vehicle
in excess of the published waiting time limit
in an area where waiting was restricted by notice
erected by London Luton Operations Limited /
in an area reserved for the use of a particular person / group /
in an area not specifically allocated for the parking of vehicles
within Luton Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence only applies to a part of the airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
